svg.title: L2O-CCG: Adversarial Learning with Set Generalization for Adaptive Robust Optimization
svg.desc: A recourse surrogate supplies gradients to a learned proximal optimizer. Set-specific projection handles uncertainty geometry. An exact recourse solve evaluates the selected scenario before the master update. Reuse a learned update rule while changing the uncertainty-set geometry. Motion illustrates algorithm steps or system behavior; it does not reproduce reported numerical results.
